ACCEPT (seat read) → PR #29979 comment 6616373413 · head `c6ac92e1` · 2026-11-03T21:55Z. Session-transfer flow: a maintainer reviews and merges; the seat marks it ready when CI is green and does not queue it.

Evidence that this is the only piece missing on a self-hosted server, from objectstack-ai/mobile#190 on an iOS simulator against `@objectstack/cli@18.3.0` with the scheme patched in.

A local proxy answered the mis-prefixed `/_console/apps/<app>/api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff?...` with a `302` to the real route. With that alone, the whole flow worked: sign-in in the auth session, the hand-off's `302` to the app, and redemption in the WebView, which opened the Console signed in.

So the app and the server both accept what the Console has to send: a same-origin navigation from `/login`. The password sign-in was the only one tried, so rule 2 (a provider's redirect chain landing on `/login` first) is still argued, not measured.
